doctrine: The Direction Stack is marketed as a diagnostic recovery system (10 protocols) for photographers fixing real failures on set, not as a generic posing guide. Revenue target: 80-165 sales in 90 days at $47/unit (baseline $3k-$7.7k). Three-product funnel: FREE Protocol 01 (email capture), CORE Manual $47 (hero), COMPANION Field Guide $15 (post-purchase upsell). Gumroad is the primary sales platform with instant PDF delivery; post-day-30, add premium tiers ($99-149 with implementation call). Launch team outreach (15-50 personal messages) is ranked #1 impact channel; Jasmine Collins (49.6k following) is the single most valuable relationship. Days 1-14: ignition (launch team, Gumroad live, email sequence, community seeding). Days 15-30: seed demand through 4 reels/week, daily stories, waitlist building. Days 31-45: 7-day hard launch window with daily emails, videos, live walkthroughs, objection handling. Days 46-60: convert winners to permanent assets (pinned reels, FAQ copy, social proof). Days 61-90: scale winners; activate customer flywheel for proof; Amazon KDP activation at day 60 (requires 20+ Gumroad reviews). Six rotating messaging angles: Failure Mode, Anti-Posing-Guide Differentiation, Operator Authority, Transformation, Identity/ICP Mirroring, Proof/Social. Strict channel separation: photography-only (never mix with Baseplate B2B). No paid ads, no new platforms, no discounts in first 90 days, no TikTok/YouTube/Flash sales. Weekly operating: Sunday planning (3 hooks, 2 emails, 3-4 videos, 1 live, collect objections), Friday review (wins/losers, one buyer quote), daily action (content OR community OR outreach OR review request OR proof capture). V2 shoot at May 1 with Jamie's studio (2-3 subjects, all 10 protocols before/after) expands to $97 product and raises V1 price to $67+. The funnel flows: Instagram content > Free Protocol PDF > 5-email sequence > Manual purchase > Field Guide upsell > Future: implementation, V2, Operator's Kit ($150+). Book serves three strategic functions: direct revenue, proof of codified system for Baseplate premium positioning, and buyer list asset for future products.

operating_rules: Market as diagnostic recovery system, not posing guide (core differentiator)
Run photography track (direct sales) and Baseplate track (authority artifact) simultaneously without mixing feeds
Launch with two products only (Free + $47 Manual); Field Guide ($15) goes live day 14+ after manual has traction
Never market Direction Stack on Baseplate/B2B account; channel separation is permanent
No paid ads in 90-day window; organic teaches what paid would cost
No new platforms added; max five platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, email, Gumroad, communities) through day 90
No discounting, flash sales, or bulk codes in first 90 days; full price builds perceived value
One hard sales CTA only: 'Get The Direction Stack' (no 'check it out' / 'tap in' / 'support me')
Do not announce V2 until V1 has 20+ reviews; let V1 establish system first
Do not send to homepage; direct all traffic to one dedicated sales page only
Ask for one genuine response (no strings) from Jasmine Collins; protect that relationship above all
Daily non-negotiable: at least one of content/community comment/outreach/review request/proof capture happens every single day
Email list converts at 5x rate of social followers; protect this asset
When content outperforms, pin and feature immediately; when it underperforms, cut it next week
content_ideas: Failure mode videos: hands looking wrong, shoulders rising, smile dying, subject freezing between frames, session sabotage, lighting good but direction fails
Protocol demonstration BTS: show directing cues in action, marked-up notes from real sets, before/after directing same subject
Operator authority posts: show protocol names, diagnostic framework, process documentation, personal system markup (makes product feel invented not generic)
Transformation angles: 'Before: I don't know what to say' to 'After: I have the exact cue', random cue vs precise diagnosis
Objection handling content: 'Is this for beginners?', 'Do I need this if I already know how to pose?', 'What if my subjects are fine?', 'How is this different from X guide?'
Proof content: marked-up protocol previews, buyer comments, buyer reactions, page snippets, social proof screenshots
Origin story: 2021 problem list, the wall hit, why this system was necessary (personal narrative)
Community participation: answer real photography questions thoroughly, add single-line Direction Stack reference at end
Carousel format: 10-protocol overview, one per slide, named and described
Video format: live walkthroughs of 1-2 protocols, Q&A format, set footage with verbal direction applied, directed subject before/after recovery
weird_gold: Psychology mechanic: 'Buy at 11pm on a Tuesday because they have a shoot at 8am Wednesday' - urgency tied to real shooter anxiety, not FOMO
One Jasmine Collins post to 49.6k could do 64 sales (full floor revenue) in a weekend - validates influencer relationship over broad audience metrics
Field Guide lamination and bag-carry positioning transforms $15 add-on into workflow tool, not digital cargo
V2 shoot strategy: one day at Jamie's studio funds entire V2 content calendar - efficiency-forward proof architecture
Customer feedback loop: ask 'which protocol hit hardest' instead of 'did you like it?' - extracts language for content and product refinement
Amazon KDP as pure discovery, Gumroad as pure profit - channel economics explicit
notes: This is a complete, execution-forward 90-day go-to-market for The Direction Stack photography book. It is authored by/for Bryce (SNIPED Media founder) and reflects the SNIPED OS principles: specificity (10 diagnostic protocols, not generic posing), operator authority (real failure modes from real sets), field manual positioning (solves active problems, not aspirational learning), and revenue clarity (80-165 sales, $3k-$7.7k revenue). The document is densely packed with tactical detail: daily operating checklists, weekly review protocols, six messaging angles, funnel structure, channel priorities ranked by impact, and hard gates (no exceptions). It integrates the Baseplate strategic layer (book as authority proof for premium implementation pricing) without muddying the photography track. The plan enforces discipline through explicitly stated 'What You Do Not Do' (no paid ads, no platform sprawl, no discounting) and daily non-negotiables. Notably, it validates the Jasmine Collins relationship as a single high-leverage asset and treats the customer email list as a 5x-multiplier on social followers. The V2 strategy (one-day shoot turning into expanded product and price raise) is a compounding efficiency play. All tactics are measurable and review-cycled weekly (Friday wins/losers, Sunday replan). No bloat, no fluff - pure action architecture.
